tasks.label: Prime System Python User Base
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && python3 -m pip install --upgrade --user pip && python3 -m pip install --user ros2-numpy && python3 -m pip install --user torch torchvision torchaudio
tasks.detail: Install node dependencies into the isolated user base (extend this command as imports grow)

tasks.label: Build STCM Package
tasks.detail: Build the STCM package with ROS sourced on the distro interpreter + isolated PYTHONUSERBASE

tasks.label: Clean Build STCM Package
tasks.command: rm -rf build/stcm install/stcm log/ && export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && colcon build --packages-select stcm --symlink-install
tasks.detail: Clean and rebuild the STCM package using the system Python runtime + isolated PYTHONUSERBASE

tasks.label: Launch Semantic Mapping
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch stcm semantic_mapping.launch.py config_file:=$(ros2 pkg prefix stcm)/share/stcm/config/semantic_mapping_params.yaml
tasks.detail: Launch semantic mapping with the config file using the system Python + isolated user base

tasks.label: Launch Semantic Mapping (with Updater)
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch stcm semantic_mapping.launch.py config_file:=$(ros2 pkg prefix stcm)/share/stcm/config/semantic_mapping_params.yaml run_updater:=true
tasks.detail: Launch semantic mapping with the updater enabled on the system Python runtime

tasks.label: Run Semantic Map Builder Node
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm semantic_map_builder --ros-args -p text_prompt:='table . chair . door .' -p graph_output_path:=/tmp/semantic_graph.json
tasks.detail: Run semantic map builder node directly with the isolated system Python user base

tasks.label: Download Model Checkpoints
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm stcm_download_checkpoints
tasks.detail: Download all default model checkpoints after sourcing ROS + workspace on system Python

tasks.label: Test GroundingDINO + MobileSAM
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && python3 stcm/test/test_gdino_sam.py stcm/imgs/irvl-clutter-test.png
tasks.detail: Test the perception pipeline on a sample image with the system Python user base

tasks.label: Test Depth Anything
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && python3 stcm/test/test_depth_anything.py stcm/imgs/color-000089.png
tasks.detail: Test depth estimation on sample image

tasks.label: Run Semantic Map Builder (Split Runtime - System Python)
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm semantic_map_builder ${input:splitBuilderArgs}
tasks.detail: Run the builder on the system interpreter (with PYTHONUSERBASE exported) while delegating perception to an external service; override args to point at your IPC endpoint

tasks.label: Run Semantic Map Updater (Split Runtime - System Python)
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm semantic_map_updater ${input:splitUpdaterArgs}
tasks.detail: Run the updater on the system interpreter (with PYTHONUSERBASE exported) while relying on a separate perception service

tasks.label: Start Perception Service (Split Runtime - System Python)
tasks.detail: Launch the Torch-heavy perception server using the same system Python + isolated user base (edit the prompted command to match your implementation)

inputs.description: Extra ros2 arguments for the builder when using the split runtime (include leading spaces, e.g., "--ros-args -p perception_endpoint:=tcp://127.0.0.1:5555")
Extra ros2 arguments for the updater in the split runtime (e.g., "--ros-args -p graph_input_path:=/tmp/semantic_graph.json")
Command that starts the perception service using the system Python + PYTHONUSERBASE (e.g., "python3 -m stcm.services.perception_server --transport=zeromq --bind=tcp://0.0.0.0:5555")
